subject: Shiny app not updating hidden sliders

messages.author: f1a78b77bed56547
messages.subject: Shiny app not updating hidden sliders
parts:
Hi,

I'm experiencing a similar (but different) issue as described at this post: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/30984195/shiny-app-not-updating-hidden-sliders

In my case, in the sidebarPanel, I create a tabsetPanel. Each tabPanel includes several sliders. When a reactive does an updateSliderInput(), it only takes effect on sliders shown in the current selected tabPanel. The hidden panel sliders do not update.

How may I force it to update sliders even if not displayed, yet retain reactivity of the outputs?

I read about the outputOptions() function, but it says the 'x' argument is 'A shinyoutput object (typically output)'. There doesn't appear to be an equivalent inputOptions() function. 

Jonathan

messages.author: f1a78b77bed56547
messages.subject: Re: Shiny app not updating hidden sliders
parts:
I tried using outputOptions on an input and it gave the expected error "x must be a shinyoutput object". Also the last comment mentions "...inputs should still be updated regardless of where they are...". However, I found this issue on github: https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/861.

This is a pretty severe limitation. Is there ANY way to brute force these hidden sliders to update? Such as programatically cycle through tabs and display them, and then return back to the original displayed tab?

Jonathan

If that's the same issue, then it was fixed a few hours ago. Try installing the latest shiny version using `devtools::install_github("rstudio/shiny")`
